channel.title: Shots
channel.description: Updates for Shots, the agent-first App Store screenshot app.

item.description:
First release

  • Record M5b as merged
  • Record the Sparkle key as backed up
  • Record M5b as built and reviewed, awaiting the merge
  • Build Shots on GitHub's runner
  • Pin the engine commit CI builds against
  • Sign updates with the Shots key and refuse a placeholder
  • Release Shots from a tag with GitHub Actions
  • Ask before replacing Shots in Applications and drop the download's quarantine
  • Update Shots with Sparkle and build a signed release with one script
  • Pin the packages the app now resolves
  • Connect Shots to Claude Code and move it to Applications on first launch
  • Let a Stop reach children launched off the main thread
  • Build shots-mcp and shots-capture into the app with the skill and driver
  • Give both tools a shared entry point and find the driver inside the app
  • Find the tools inside the app unless a Settings path says otherwise
  • Build Shots on GitHub's runner
  • Record three lessons from M5a's live pass and polish
  • Record the M5b plan as next in the status
  • Write the Milestone 5b plan and align the spec with Brio's feed
  • Write the Milestone 5b distribution spec
